# Psalm 123 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-song of-the-ascents. To-you I-lift my-eyes, the-one-dwelling in-the-heavens.

**2** Behold as-eyes-of servants to-hand-of their-master, as-eyes-of a-maidservant to-hand-of her-mistress, so our-eyes to-YHWH our-God, until he-is-gracious-to-us.

**3** Be-gracious-to-us O-YHWH, be-gracious-to-us, for greatly we-are-filled-with contempt.

**4** Greatly is-filled our-soul the-scorn-of the-at-ease, the-contempt-of the-proud.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **123:2**: The servant/maidservant analogy — eyes fixed on the master's hand, watching for provision, direction, or mercy. Total dependence.

— EMET
